titulo: Poder in the present perfect and the preterite (could in the past)
subtitulo: No he podido dormir / No pude dormir.
regla: He podido and pude both mean was able to / managed to. Present perfect: the time frame is still open or not mentioned (hoy, este mes). Preterite: a finished time (ayer, el año pasado). In Mexico the preterite is used much more, even for today.

bloques.texto: To say someone **was able / wasn't able** to do something, use **poder** + infinitive in the **present perfect** or the **preterite**.

filas: time not mentioned, or a time frame you're still in: hoy, esta mañana, este mes
a specific, finished time: ayer, el lunes, al final

bloques.texto: **In Mexico**, the preterite is used far more, even for today: **¿Pudiste comprar fruta?** is more natural than **¿Has podido...?** The present perfect is common for _so far / lately_: **no he podido dormir bien estos días**.
Tip: **he podido** keeps the door open; **pude** closes it.

lista.en: Were you able to buy fruit? —No, I wasn't.

lista.es: Esther ==ha podido== reservar mesa esta mañana.
lista.en: Esther was able to book a table this morning.

lista.es: Mi inquilino no ==ha podido== pagar la renta este mes.
lista.en: My tenant hasn't been able to pay the rent this month.

lista.es: No ==he podido== ir a muchas fiestas en los últimos meses.
lista.en: I haven't been able to go to many parties in the last few months.
Sorry, I couldn't call you yesterday.

lista.es: Al final ella ==pudo== recuperar su dinero.
lista.en: In the end she managed to get her money back.

lista.es: No ==pudimos== conseguir boletos para el concierto.
lista.en: We couldn't get tickets for the concert.
Were you able to get hold of your lawyer?

lista.es: El plomero no ==pudo== arreglar la llave.
lista.en: The plumber couldn't fix the faucet.

filas.t: El lunes no he podido llegar a tiempo a clase.
El lunes no pude llegar a tiempo a clase.

bloques.texto: Say it out loud, then open the answer.

lista.p: In Spanish: _I couldn't sleep last night._
In Spanish: _I haven't been able to rest this week._
lista.r: Esta semana no he podido descansar.

lista.p: In Spanish: _Did you manage to fix it?_ (tú, Mexico)
